questions.question: We are about to refactor the renderer to better support cross-repo session orchestration; this will touch the worktree manager, the session state machine, the persistence layer, and a handful of widgets in the TUI — before we proceed, can you confirm whether you would like the migration to preserve existing on-disk session metadata, drop and recreate it on first launch, or attempt a best-effort upgrade with a rollback path that keeps the previous JSON files under sessions.json.bak so a downgrade is possible without manual cleanup, and please also indicate whether the rollback artifact should be retained indefinitely or garbage-collected after a successful run?
Anything else the agent should know?
